title: Batumi Beauty Salon Website Audit
executiveSummary: This popular Batumi beauty salon has a strong Instagram presence but a website that doesn't convert. There's no service menu with prices, no online booking, and no clear path from discovery to appointment. Most bookings still come through Instagram DMs — an unscalable, error-prone process.

findings.title: No online booking system
findings.description: All appointments are managed through Instagram DMs and phone calls. This creates scheduling conflicts, missed messages, and limits availability to business hours. Clients who prefer booking online simply go elsewhere.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement an online booking system with service selection, stylist preference, available time slots, and automatic confirmation via SMS or WhatsApp.

findings.title: No service menu or pricing
findings.description: The website doesn't list services or prices. Every potential client has to call or DM to find out basic information. This friction causes drop-off — especially for new clients comparison shopping.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a clear service menu with categories, descriptions, duration estimates, and price ranges. Include a 'Book this service' CTA next to each item.

findings.title: Invisible in local beauty searches
findings.description: The salon doesn't appear in Google searches for 'beauty salon Batumi' or 'nail studio Batumi'. No Google Business Profile optimization, no local keywords, and no structured data markup. Instagram doesn't rank in Google search results.
findings.recommendedFix: Set up and optimize Google Business Profile with complete service listings, add LocalBusiness schema markup, create location-specific content pages, and build citations in local directories.

findings.title: Slow-feeling mobile first load
findings.description: The homepage feels heavier than it needs to on mobile because social embeds and large media compete with the first booking decision. Visitors arriving from Instagram or Google need service, price, proof, and contact details quickly.
findings.recommendedFix: Replace heavy embeds with lightweight image galleries, optimize images, lazy-load non-critical media, and test the first screen on real mobile connections before launch.
